S1_IPC_STRIPS.authorship: International Planning Competition (IPC) public PDDL domains and their public instance generators, authored by the external planning community; transcribed into the repo with per-file provenance (domain name, IPC year, canonical public source reference). The taxonomy (PDDL types/actions/effects) is external to and disjoint from the OCM typed-operator DAG taxonomy by construction; the transcription records prove it.
S1_IPC_STRIPS.why_primary: family structure is real and graded (same domain, growing instance size) which is what FE-DEV-AMORT-1's related-task-family acquisition-cost design needs; plan validation is EXACT; D25's planned STRIPS substrate aligns; no data custody outside the repo beyond the transcription itself
S1_IPC_STRIPS.families: the transcribed IPC domain set (target >= 3 materially different domains at freeze time; final list frozen in the family table emitted by the build)
S1_IPC_STRIPS.instance_generation: public generator semantics re-implemented faithfully at the generator's OWN default parameters with a frozen seed; NO rejection sampling, NO difficulty filtering, NO oracle-informed selection; the stream is taken as authored; parse failures are the only exclusions and are retained with reasons

S2_BLIMP_UD.authorship: BLiMP (Warstadt et al. 2020) 67 phenomena x 1000 minimal pairs and Universal Dependencies English EWT; externally authored and externally labelled; custody via existing ~/ocm-data sha manifests on billy-old (harness src/ocm/evaluation/m7_blimp_ud.py)

independent_truth.S1_checker: a plan validator implemented to the public PDDL STRIPS semantics (types, preconditions, delete/add effects, goal test) as a SEPARATE frozen module: it imports nothing from the mechanism (src/ocm), nothing from the family emitters, and validates a candidate plan against the domain theory + instance facts only. It is the 'frozen independent oracle' of the policy table. Validator sha is frozen in the family table.
independent_truth.label_recovery_rule: truth labels are RECOVERED by the validator (plan accepted/rejected; goal reached), never read from any generator intent field; generator-intent fields (intended plan length, generator notes) are audit-only and retained
independent_truth.fail_closed: any family member whose truth cannot be recovered (unparseable domain/instance, validator CANNOT_CHECK) is retained with status CANNOT_CHECK and excluded from scoring; no fallback to intent
hostile_validation_required_before_use: planted-invalid plans (precondition violation, wrong delete effect, goal not reached) MUST be rejected by the validator
a tampered domain (one changed precondition) MUST change at least one previously-valid plan's verdict -- proves the validator actually reads the domain theory
no-alarm case asserted: the clean family set produces zero CANNOT_CHECK and zero rejected-valid

p1_selftest.py: runs the four hostile cases above + the no-alarm case; distinct exit codes per failure class; sub-second on toy data (legal on any host); real family emission runs on laptop billy / billy-old / LUNARC only, never Mac mini
